title: Power SMP
description: Power SMP is a Minecraft mod that provides amulets that you can craft and that offer unique powers (this mod is for public use, anyone can use it).
body:
🇫🇷
#  ⚡ Power SMP Mod [BETA]
## ⚠️ Bêta

### 🎮 Recommandé pour


SMP


PvP



### ✨ Description
Le Power SMP est un mod unique qui transforme complètement l’expérience multijoueur grâce à un système d’amulettes de pouvoirs. Chaque amulette possède des capacités spéciales qui permettent aux joueurs de créer leur propre style de jeu.

**🔥 Amulettes disponibles**


**🦊 Fox Amulet**

![Fox](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/77670f1c966cc06d7d0246de5cd7bd84e54fdece.png)

**🐹 Hamster Amulet**

![Hamster](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dd2e88f003a48e6b0bf0c02fb253bc5e16e61230.png)

**💪 Strength Amulet**

![Strenght](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd893aa328f561c297a77eadedd5c812dfeaef3b_0.webp)

**💥 Creeper Amulet**

![Creeper](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e2694ac723adcc8560e3e8db1fbcff595f86d9bb.png)


## ⬆️ Système d’amélioration
Les amulettes peuvent être améliorées au fil de votre progression afin de débloquer de nouveaux pouvoirs et rendre vos capacités encore plus puissantes.

![Upgrade](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3306233ec482bb1e91c79df2faec054db24667e4.png)

🌍
**Chaque joueur peut choisir son propre pouvoir et développer son gameplay**, ce qui rend chaque SMP plus dynamique et stratégique.

## 🛠️ Informations

Ce mod a été créé à l’origine pour un ancien SMP, il est donc normal que quelques bugs soient encore présents 😄

🇬🇧
# ⚡ Power SMP Mod [BETA]
## ⚠️ Beta
This mod is currently in BETA. Bugs may still be present and some features may change or be improved in future updates.
🎮 Recommended for


SMP


PvP




### ✨ Description
Power SMP is a unique mod that completely transforms the multiplayer experience with a power amulet system. Each amulet gives players special abilities and allows them to create their own playstyle.

**🔥 Available Amulets**


**🦊 Fox Amulet**

![Fox](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/77670f1c966cc06d7d0246de5cd7bd84e54fdece.png)

**🐹 Hamster Amulet**

![Hamster](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dd2e88f003a48e6b0bf0c02fb253bc5e16e61230.png)

**💪 Strength Amulet**

![Strenght](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd893aa328f561c297a77eadedd5c812dfeaef3b_0.webp)

**💥 Creeper Amulet**

![Creeper](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e2694ac723adcc8560e3e8db1fbcff595f86d9bb.png)

## ⬆️ Upgrade System
Amulets can be upgraded as you progress, unlocking new abilities and making your powers even stronger.

![Upgrade](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3306233ec482bb1e91c79df2faec054db24667e4.png)

**🌍 A different experience every game**
Each player can choose their own power and evolve their gameplay, making every SMP more dynamic and strategic.

## 🛠️ Information
This mod was originally created for an old SMP, so it’s normal if you encounter a few bugs 😄
